title: Bar Drop Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum by Drop is a fun, confectionery-inspired blend. It pairs the juicy, fresh taste of strawberry and watermelon with a sweet, sugary bubblegum base. The result is a smooth, chewy-tasting vape that balances fruit freshness with candy sweetness. Mixed with a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid is designed to maximise the impact of the sugary bubblegum notes while keeping the fruit flavours clear. Ideally suited for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) starter kits, the nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth, gentle throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
